## Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] All tests pass (`npm run test:all` — 98 assertions)
- [ ] Commit messages follow conventional commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, etc.)
- [ ] New skills/modules have corresponding tests in `tests/`
- [ ] Memory file changes are backwards-compatible (skeletons remain valid JSON)
- [ ] Schema changes (run-config, memory) are documented
- [ ] No secrets or credentials in committed files
- [ ] README.md updated if pipeline flow or CLI flags changed

## Type of Change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] refactor — code restructuring
- [ ] test — test additions/changes
- [ ] chore — build/CI/config
